2927      async def _stream_model(
 2928          self, gateway: ModelGateway, state: AgentRunState, request: ModelRequest
 2929      ):
 2930          stream = gateway.stream_resolved(self.context, state["spec"].model_plan, request)
 2931          self.active_model_stream = stream
 2932          content_parts: list[str] = []
 2933          tool_parts: dict[int, dict[str, Any]] = {}
 2934          usage = None
 2935          response: ModelResponse | None = None
 2936          try:
 2937              async for event in stream:
 2938                  if event.event_type is ModelStreamEventType.MESSAGE_DELTA:
 2939                      delta = event.message_delta or ""
 2940                      content_parts.append(delta)
 2941                      if delta:
 2942                          await self._emit(AgentEventType.MESSAGE_DELTA, {"delta": delta})
 2943                  elif event.event_type is ModelStreamEventType.TOOL_CALL_DELTA:
 2944                      delta = event.tool_call_delta
 2945                      if delta is not None:
 2946                          _append_tool_call_delta(tool_parts, delta)
 2947                  elif event.event_type is ModelStreamEventType.USAGE:
 2948                      usage = event.usage
 2949                      if usage is not None:
 2950                          usage_data: dict[str, Any] = {
 2951                              "input_tokens": usage.input_tokens,
 2952                              "output_tokens": usage.output_tokens,
 2953                              "total_tokens": usage.total_tokens,
 2954                          }
 2955                          if usage.cached_tokens is not None:
 2956                              usage_data["cached_tokens"] = usage.cached_tokens
 2957                          await self._emit(AgentEventType.USAGE, usage_data)
 2958                  elif event.event_type is ModelStreamEventType.COMPLETED:

 2961                  raise ModelGatewayError(ModelGatewayErrorCode.MODEL_BAD_RESPONSE)

 2964              return response

155  def validate_dataset_items(items: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
  156      if not isinstance(items, Sequence) or isinstance(items, (str, bytes)) or not items:
  157          raise AgentHubError(
  158              "EVALUATION_DATASET_INVALID", "A dataset version requires at least one item.", 422
  159          )
  160      normalized = [validate_dataset_item(item) for item in items]
  161      case_keys = [item["case_key"] for item in normalized]
  162      if len(case_keys) != len(set(case_keys)):
  163          raise AgentHubError(
  164              "EVALUATION_DATASET_DUPLICATE_CASE_KEY",
  165              "case_key must be unique within a dataset version.",
  166              422,
  167          )
  168      ordinals = [item["ordinal"] for item in normalized]
  169      if len(ordinals) != len(set(ordinals)):
  170          raise AgentHubError(
  171              "EVALUATION_DATASET_INVALID", "ordinal must be unique within a dataset version.", 422
  172          )
  173  
  174      input_hashes: set[str] = set()
  175      provenance_hashes: set[str] = set()
  176      for item in normalized:
  177          input_identity = canonical_json_hash({"category": item["category"], "input": item["input"]})
  178          if input_identity in input_hashes:
  179              raise AgentHubError(
  180                  "EVALUATION_DATASET_DUPLICATE_INPUT",
  181                  "Dataset items must not repeat a normalized input across splits.",
  182                  422,
  183              )
  184          input_hashes.add(input_identity)
  185          provenance_identity = canonical_json_hash(item["source_provenance"])
  186          if provenance_identity in provenance_hashes:
  187              raise AgentHubError(
  188                  "EVALUATION_DATASET_DUPLICATE_PROVENANCE",
  189                  "Dataset source provenance must identify each source case once.",
  190                  422,
  191              )
  192          provenance_hashes.add(provenance_identity)
  193      return sorted(normalized, key=lambda item: (item["ordinal"], item["case_key"]))
